scope: Belgian award entries in the WMI catalogue; candidate list spans historic and current award pages
sources.download_method: 100 linked object pages opened from the master text list; selected existing direct image files matched by exact source image URL and page caption
sources.coverage_result: 100/100 listed WMI object pages opened and represented in the candidate JSONL. This pictured batch contains 30 distinct formal-award families, 30 complete fronts, 28 matching backs, and 58 decoded local images, all contact-sheet visually reviewed. 70 catalog entries were outside this pictured batch. Source sweep completion applies only to this WMI directory, not national completeness.
sources.image_quality: All 58 source images decode and were visually reviewed in contact sheets; each retains the complete visible award and its source caption. Source image long edge is 250px; retained as low-resolution references. Two families have only a front view in the downloaded source set.
sources.rights_status: Source pages do not state photographer or redistribution terms; preserve attribution and treat publication rights as unverified.
